title: tragacantha lapponica
intro: Tragacantha lapponica, commonly known as Devil's thorn or Cloudberry trefoil, is a flowering plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support cardiovascular health, lower cholesterol levels, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha lapponica include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and vasodilatory effects, which may help to alleviate conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and hypertension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
